name: no_loose_triangle_of_expandable_sets
lines: A B S T : Finset V
⊢ x ∈ S ∩ B ↔ x ∈ A ∩ B
⊢ x ∈ S ∧ x ∈ B ↔ x ∈ A ∧ x ∈ B
⊢ x ∈ S ∧ x ∈ B → x ∈ A ∧ x ∈ B
⊢ x ∈ A ∧ x ∈ B → x ∈ S ∧ x ∈ B
h_no_lt : ∀ e₁ ∈ H, ∀ e₂ ∈ H, ∀ e₃ ∈ H, ¬is_loose_triangle e₁ e₂ e₃
hlt : X₁ ≠ X₂ ∧ X₂ ≠ X₃ ∧ X₁ ≠ X₃ ∧ (X₁ ∩ X₂).card = 1 ∧ (X₂ ∩ X₃).card = 1 ∧ (X₃ ∩ X₁).card = 1 ∧ Disjoint (X₁ ∩ X₂) X₃
hexp₁ : ∀ (Y : Finset V), Disjoint Y X₁ → Y.card ≤ 2 * r → ∃ e ∈ H, X₁ ⊆ e ∧ Disjoint e Y
hexp₂ : ∀ (Y : Finset V), Disjoint Y X₂ → Y.card ≤ 2 * r → ∃ e ∈ H, X₂ ⊆ e ∧ Disjoint e Y
hexp₃ : ∀ (Y : Finset V), Disjoint Y X₃ → Y.card ≤ 2 * r → ∃ e ∈ H, X₃ ⊆ e ∧ Disjoint e Y
⊢ e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧ e₂ ≠ e₃ ∧ e₁ ≠ e₃ ∧ (e₁ ∩ e₂).card = 1 ∧ (e₂ ∩ e₃).card = 1 ∧ (e₃ ∩ e₁).card = 1 ∧ Disjoint (e₁ ∩ e₂) e₃
